title: Memories of My Melancholy Whores

vibeProfile.oneLine: At ninety, a man falls in love for the very first time.

summary: On his ninetieth birthday, a lifelong bachelor and undistinguished journalist decides to give himself a night with a young virgin, and instead falls, hopelessly and for the first time, into love. Marquez's short final novel is a slender, controversial coda to his career, a meditation on age, desire and the strange lateness of a first real feeling. Told in his warm, ironic late style, it is less a story than a long, rueful sigh about a life half-lived and love arriving far too late to do much good.
whyReadIt: A short, bittersweet farewell from a master, about love arriving impossibly late. Slight, but it lingers.

funFacts.text: It was the last novel Marquez published before his death in 2014.
